<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern, the strong M+2 peak at ~33 % of the base peak matches the natural abundance of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl). The noticeable M+1 peak (~13 % of the base) is consistent with the presence of carbon (13C) in an organic molecule. No other element shows a characteristic pattern of this magnitude. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
